question.:question/problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
\begin{aligned}x&=t^{2}\\ y&=\left(2 - t\right) \left(t + 3\right)\\ &-5\le t\le 5\end{aligned}
$$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First calculate the $x$-values using $x=t^{2}$:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & -5 & -4 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ \hline x & 25 & 16 & 9 & 4 & 1 \\ \hline y &  &  &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & 0 & 1 & 4 & 9 & 16 \\ \hline y &  &  &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 5 \\ \hline x & 25 \\ \hline y &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=\left(2 - t\right) \left(t + 3\right)$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & -5 & -4 & -3 & -2 & -1 \\ \hline x & 25 & 16 & 9 & 4 & 1 \\ \hline y & -14 & -6 & 0 & 4 & 6 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & 0 & 1 & 4 & 9 & 16 \\ \hline y & 6 & 4 & 0 & -6 & -14 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 5 \\ \hline x & 25 \\ \hline y & -24 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Pair the coordinates at the same parameter value and follow the curve only over the stated interval.

question.:question/problem:

$$
\begin{aligned}x&=7 \cos{\left(\theta \right)}\\ y&=5 \sin{\left(\theta \right)}\\ &0\le \theta \le 2\pi \end{aligned}

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & 0 & \frac{\pi}{6} & \frac{\pi}{3} \\ \hline x & 7 & \frac{7 \sqrt{3}}{2} & \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & \frac{2 \pi}{3} & \pi & \frac{4 \pi}{3} \\ \hline x & - \frac{7}{2} & -7 & - \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & \frac{5 \pi}{3} \\ \hline x & \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=5 \sin{\left(\theta \right)}$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & 0 & \frac{\pi}{6} & \frac{\pi}{3} \\ \hline x & 7 & \frac{7 \sqrt{3}}{2} & \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y & 0 & \frac{5}{2} & \frac{5 \sqrt{3}}{2} \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & \frac{2 \pi}{3} & \pi & \frac{4 \pi}{3} \\ \hline x & - \frac{7}{2} & -7 & - \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y & \frac{5 \sqrt{3}}{2} & 0 & - \frac{5 \sqrt{3}}{2} \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{\theta} & \frac{5 \pi}{3} \\ \hline x & \frac{7}{2} \\ \hline y & - \frac{5 \sqrt{3}}{2} \\ \hline\end{array}
